name: Should I try to patch the wall or ceiling myself, or hire a pro?

mainEntity.name: Should I try to patch the wall or ceiling myself, or hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing DIY and professional repair, the main difference is finish quality and hidden-damage detection. DIY can work for tiny cosmetic patches, but professional repair is usually the safer choice for seams, sagging ceilings, water stains, or texture matching.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for small cosmetic damage, but professionals are better for leaks, sagging, seams, and texture matching.
